title: Precision UI Refinements: Kanban Card Timer, Todo Contrast, Diff Sidebar Default Collapsed, Stepper Border, Steer Footer
commitMessage: feat(ui): implement 5 precision UI refinements for timer, todo contrast, diff sidebar, stepper border and steer footer
author: Lead UI Artisan (react-tailwind-artisan)

sensors.l2_reviewer: APPROVED (100% FTR, 0 review returns, 0 linter errors)

summary: Implemented 5 precision UI refinements across Kanban card and drawer components: (1) integrated real-time MM:SS stage timer directly into KanbanCard 'running' status badge and removed redundant bottom-row clock metadata; (2) enhanced TaskTodoWidget dark mode contrast and tactile amber styling for active steps; (3) set GitDiffSidebar files to default collapsed on initial task load to prevent diff bloat; (4) removed redundant inner border from DrawerHeader stage stepper pill; and (5) removed top border on DrawerSteerBar footer for seamless floating layout.
